title: Countryside
about: Collocations for describing the countryside and for the language of tourism, such as open fields, a steep slope, catch a glimpse of, breathtaking scenery and a secluded beach.

items.pattern: the surrounding countryside / area / villages / hills
items.meaning: the countryside all around a town, village or building
items.example: We rented bikes and spent the whole day exploring the **surrounding countryside**.
more: Our campsite is on a hill, so you can see the **surrounding countryside** from your tent.
The town itself is small, but the **surrounding villages** have lovely old pubs.
items.watchOut: Countryside — незлічуване: the countryside, без a і без -s. Surrounding стоїть перед іменником (the surrounding countryside); після іменника кажуть around: the countryside around the town.

items.pattern: a familiar landscape / face / sight / place
items.meaning: a landscape you know well because you have seen it many times, often since you were a child
items.example: When the train left the city, I saw the **familiar landscape** of my childhood: flat fields, a river and an old water tower.
more: It was lovely to see a **familiar face** at the airport after six months abroad.
Mum painted the **familiar landscape** of her village from memory: the church, the pond and the poplars.
items.watchOut: Знайомий — familiar, а не family (сім'я) і не known: a familiar landscape, a familiar face. Наголос на другий склад: fa-MIL-iar.

items.pattern: a gentle landscape · gentle hills / slopes
items.meaning: a soft, calm landscape with low rounded hills and nothing wild or frightening about it
items.example: If you're not a keen walker, you'll love the **gentle landscape** of the south, with its low hills and quiet farms.
more: The cycle route goes through a **gentle landscape** of orchards and meadows, so it's ideal for children.
Grandma prefers walks on **gentle slopes**, not steep mountain paths.
items.watchOut: М'який клімат — a mild climate, але м'який, лагідний краєвид — a gentle landscape, а не a mild landscape. Пологі пагорби — gentle hills.

items.pattern: open fields / countryside / land
items.meaning: wide fields with no woods, houses or walls in the way
items.example: Once we left the village, there was nothing but **open fields** all the way to the horizon.
more: Our dog loves running across the **open fields** behind the house.
It's always windy up there because it's all **open land** with no trees.
items.watchOut: Open fields — простір, де нічого не заступає горизонт. Голі поля, на яких нічого не росте, — bare fields, а не naked fields.

items.pattern: a bleak landscape / moor / hillside
items.meaning: a cold, empty landscape with few trees or houses, which feels sad and unwelcoming
items.example: In November the moors are a **bleak landscape** of grey sky, wet grass and wind.
more: The coach drove for hours through a **bleak landscape** without a single village.
The old mining town lies in a **bleak landscape**, but the people there are very friendly.
items.watchOut: Похмурий, непривітний краєвид — a bleak landscape. Severe (суворий) про краєвид зазвичай не кажуть: severe — про погоду, біль, покарання (a severe winter).

items.pattern: rocky mountains / hills / ground / coast / path
items.meaning: mountains covered with rocks, with little grass and few trees
items.example: Behind the village there are **rocky mountains** where goats climb almost to the top.
more: Wear proper boots: the path to the lake is very **rocky**.
The island has a **rocky coast** with only two small beaches.
items.watchOut: Скелясті гори — rocky mountains, а не rock mountains. Stony частіше кажуть про дрібне каміння: a stony path, a stony beach. Rocky Mountains з великої літери — гори в Північній Америці.

items.pattern: follow a path / a track / the river / the signs
items.meaning: walk along a path in the direction it goes
items.example: We **followed a path** through the woods and came out right next to a little pub.
more: If you **follow the river**, you'll reach the next village in about an hour.
**Follow the signs** for the waterfall and don't leave the track.
items.watchOut: Іти стежкою — follow a path або walk along a path, а не go by the path.

items.pattern: turn a / the corner · go / come round the corner
items.meaning: walk or drive round a corner so that you go in a new direction
items.example: As soon as we **turned the corner**, we could smell the sea.
more: The bus stop is just after you **turn the corner** by the bakery.
I **turned the corner** too fast on my bike and nearly hit a parked car.
items.watchOut: Повернути за ріг — turn the corner, а не turn behind the corner і не return the corner (return — повернутися назад). Ріг вулиці — corner, а не angle: angle — кут у геометрії.

items.pattern: catch / get a glimpse of sb/sth · a brief glimpse
items.meaning: see something for only a moment, so you don't see it fully
items.example: From the train window I **caught a glimpse of** a deer at the edge of the field.
more: Hundreds of fans waited outside the hotel to **catch a glimpse of** the band.
Through a gap in the clouds we **got a brief glimpse of** the top of the mountain.
items.watchOut: Мигцем побачити — catch (або get) a glimpse of, а не make a glimpse. Не плутай з glance — швидкий погляд, який кидаєш сам: I glanced at my watch.

items.pattern: take a picture / a photo / photographs (of sb/sth)
items.meaning: make a photograph with a camera or phone
items.example: Excuse me, could you **take a picture** of us with the lake behind?
more: We **took lots of photos** on our trip, but only ten are any good.
You're not allowed to **take pictures** inside the museum.
items.watchOut: Зробити фото — take a photo / take a picture, а не make a photo. «Сфотографуй мене» — Can you take a picture of me?

items.pattern: catch sight of sb/sth · lose sight of sb/sth
items.meaning: suddenly see someone or something, often for the first time
items.example: The children screamed with joy when they **caught sight of** the sea.
more: As soon as the dog **caught sight of** a rabbit, it ran off across the field.
Hold my hand in the crowd: I don't want to **lose sight of** you.
items.watchOut: Catch sight of — без артикля: не catch a sight of. Catch sight of — раптом побачити; catch a glimpse of — побачити лише на мить, частково. Lose sight of — втратити з поля зору.

items.pattern: round a bend / a corner · come / go round a bend · a bend in the road / river
items.meaning: go round a curve in a road, path or river
items.example: We **rounded a bend** in the road and suddenly saw the whole lake below us.
more: Slow down: there's a sharp **bend** just before the bridge.
The boat **came round the bend** in the river and an old mill appeared.
items.watchOut: Round тут — дієслово: обігнути (we rounded a bend). Поворот дороги чи річки — a bend, а ріг вулиці чи будинку — a corner.

items.pattern: come into view · disappear from view · come into sight
items.meaning: begin to be seen as you get closer
items.example: After two hours of climbing, the hut finally **came into view**.
more: The kids started cheering when the campsite **came into view**.
As the plane came down through the clouds, the city lights **came into view**.
items.watchOut: Показатися, з'явитися — come into view, без артикля: не come into the view. Зникнути — disappear from view.

items.pattern: fall into ruin / disrepair · fall – fell – fallen
items.meaning: slowly become a ruin because nobody looks after it
items.example: Nobody has lived in the old mill for decades, and it has **fallen into ruin**.
more: The church **fell into ruin** after everyone left the village.
If nobody repairs the roof, the farmhouse will **fall into disrepair**.
items.watchOut: Занепасти — fall into ruin (ruin в однині, без артикля) або fall into disrepair. Не come into ruin.

items.pattern: lie in ruins · be in ruins · lie – lay – lain
items.meaning: be badly damaged or destroyed, so that only parts of the walls are left
items.example: The fortress on the hill **lies in ruins**, but you can still climb the tower.
more: After the earthquake, half the old town **lay in ruins**.
The monastery has **been in ruins** for centuries, but it's a lovely place for a picnic.
items.watchOut: Лежати в руїнах — lie in ruins (ruins у множині, прийменник in), а не lie on ruins. Минулий час — lay, а не laid: the town lay in ruins.

items.pattern: be well worth seeing / visiting / a visit
items.meaning: definitely good enough to spend time going to see
items.example: The caves are a bit far from town, but they're **well worth seeing**.
more: If you're in the area, the Sunday market is **well worth a visit**.
The walk to the lighthouse is long, but the view at the end makes it **well worth it**.
items.watchOut: Дуже варто — well worth, а не very worth і не a lot worth. Після worth — дієслово з -ing або іменник: worth seeing, worth a visit, а не worth to see.

items.pattern: a dramatic / beautiful / stunning setting · in a … setting
items.meaning: a very striking and impressive place where something is
items.example: The little chapel stands in a **dramatic setting** on top of the cliffs.
more: The open-air theatre has a **dramatic setting** in an old quarry.
The campsite has a **beautiful setting** between two waterfalls.
items.watchOut: Місце з усім, що довкола, — a setting, а не a set (set — знімальний майданчик або набір). З прийменником in: in a dramatic setting.

items.pattern: a steep slope / hill / path / climb
items.meaning: a slope that goes up or down very sharply
items.example: Grandad couldn't manage the **steep slope** down to the beach, so we went another way.
more: My bike is too heavy to push up such a **steep hill**.
The last part of the path is very **steep**, so take your time.
items.watchOut: Крутий схил — a steep slope, а не a cool slope (cool — прохолодний або класний). Різкий поворот — a sharp bend, а схил — steep.

items.pattern: a fast-flowing / slow-flowing river / stream
items.meaning: a river in which the water moves very quickly
items.example: Don't let the kids swim here: it's a **fast-flowing river** and the water is freezing.
more: We crossed a **fast-flowing stream** by jumping from stone to stone.
The village lies beside a **slow-flowing river** where people fish on summer evenings.
items.watchOut: Бурхлива річка — a fast-flowing river; stormy кажуть про море чи погоду (a stormy sea). Перед іменником — через дефіс: a fast-flowing river.

items.pattern: mountains / cliffs tower above / over sth · towering mountains
items.meaning: rise very high above something in a dramatic way
items.example: The village is tiny, and the **mountains tower above** it on every side.
more: We had lunch on the beach with white cliffs **towering above** us.
The **towering mountains** made our tent look like a toy.
items.watchOut: Tower тут — дієслово: височіти, здійматися. Прийменник — above або over: towered above the lake, а не on the lake.

items.pattern: unspoilt countryside / beaches / villages · unspoiled (US)
items.meaning: countryside that has not been changed by industry, roads or modern buildings
items.example: We chose this area for our holiday because of its **unspoilt countryside** and quiet roads.
more: The island still has **unspoilt beaches** with no hotels at all.
My aunt lives in an **unspoilt village** where the houses haven't changed for two hundred years.
items.watchOut: «На природі», «за містом» — in the countryside, а не in the nature: we spent the weekend in the countryside. Британське написання — unspoilt, американське — unspoiled.

items.pattern: a dense / thick forest · dense jungle / fog
items.meaning: a forest where the trees grow very close together
items.example: The path disappeared into a **dense forest**, and we were glad we had a map.
more: Behind the house there's a **thick forest** full of mushrooms in autumn.
We drove slowly because of the **dense fog** on the motorway.
items.watchOut: Густий ліс — a dense (або thick) forest, а не a fat forest і не a tight forest. Густий туман — dense / thick fog, а не strong fog.

items.pattern: block the view (of sth) · block sb's view · obstruct the view (formal)
items.meaning: be in front of something so that people cannot see it
items.example: A huge lorry parked outside our window and **blocked the view** of the sea.
more: Could you move a bit to the left? You're **blocking my view**.
The trees have grown so tall that they **block the view** of the lake from our balcony.
items.watchOut: Закривати вид — block the view, а не close the view і не stop the view. «Ти мені заступаєш» — You're blocking my view.

items.pattern: snow-covered mountains / peaks / roofs · snow-capped peaks
items.meaning: mountains with snow lying on them
items.example: In April you can sit outside a café in the sun and look at **snow-covered mountains**.
more: The village looked like a Christmas card with all its **snow-covered roofs**.
From the plane we could see **snow-capped peaks** for miles.
items.watchOut: Засніжені гори — snow-covered (або snow-capped) mountains. Snowy зазвичай кажуть про погоду й час: a snowy day, a snowy winter.

items.pattern: a stream / river / road / path winds through / along / up sth · wind – wound – wound · a winding road
items.meaning: bends and turns a lot instead of going in a straight line
items.example: A little **stream winds** through the meadow behind my grandparents' house.
more: The road **winds** up the hill in a series of tight bends.
We followed a **winding** path down to the beach.
items.watchOut: Тут wind читається /waɪnd/, як find, а не як вітер /wɪnd/. Минулий час — wound /waʊnd/: the river wound through the valley. Звивиста дорога — a winding road.

items.pattern: destroy / ruin / spoil the countryside · destroy the environment
items.meaning: damage the countryside so badly that it cannot recover
items.example: Many people think the new motorway will **destroy the countryside** around the village.
more: One huge car park could **destroy** this beautiful valley for ever.
Plastic waste is slowly **destroying the environment**.
items.watchOut: Destroy — знищити повністю, так що вже не відновити. Spoil — лише зіпсувати, зробити гіршим: the new pylons spoil the view.

items.pattern: protect the environment / wildlife / the countryside
items.meaning: keep the natural world safe from damage
items.example: Our school runs a recycling club to teach kids how to **protect the environment**.
more: Visitors must stay on the paths to **protect** the rare plants.
Local people raised money to **protect the countryside** from new building.
items.watchOut: Охороняти довкілля — protect the environment, а не guard the environment (guard — стерегти, як охоронець). «Охороняти природу» — protect nature, без the.

items.pattern: an uninterrupted view (of sth) · uninterrupted views
items.meaning: a view with nothing in the way, so you can see everything
items.uk: вид, який ніщо не заступає; відкритий вид
items.example: Our tent was right on the cliff edge, with an **uninterrupted view** of the bay.
more: Ask for a front seat on the bus and you'll get **uninterrupted views** of the mountains.
The flat's best feature is an **uninterrupted view** across the park.
items.watchOut: Відкритий вид — an uninterrupted (або a clear) view, а не a free view: a free view — вид, за який не треба платити.

items.pattern: a panoramic view (of / over / across sth) · panoramic views
items.meaning: a view over a very wide area
items.example: From the top of the hill you get a **panoramic view** over the whole valley.
more: The cable car has glass walls, so you get a **panoramic view** all the way up.
There's a café on the roof with **panoramic views** of the harbour.

items.pattern: a spectacular view / sunset / scenery
items.meaning: a very impressive and dramatic view
items.example: We got up at five, climbed the hill and had a **spectacular view** of the sunrise.
more: The road over the pass has some **spectacular views**, so take your camera.
Last night there was a **spectacular sunset** over the lake.
items.watchOut: Прикметник — spectacular, а не spectacle: spectacle — іменник «видовище». Наголос: spec-TAC-u-lar.

items.pattern: enjoy / admire the view · stop to admire the view
items.meaning: look at a beautiful view with pleasure
items.example: Let's sit on this bench for a minute and **enjoy the view**.
more: Halfway up the tower we stopped to catch our breath and **admire the view**.
Grandma sat by the window all afternoon, **enjoying the view** of the garden.
items.watchOut: Милуватися видом — admire / enjoy the view, без прийменника: не admire on the view і не look on the view.

items.pattern: breathtaking / stunning / spectacular scenery · breathtaking views
items.meaning: landscape so beautiful that it is very exciting to see
items.example: The train journey takes eight hours, but the **breathtaking scenery** makes the time fly.
more: We drove along the coast through some **breathtaking scenery**.
The photos don't show how **breathtaking** the views really are.
items.watchOut: Scenery — незлічуване: some breathtaking scenery, без a і без -s (не sceneries). Вимова: /ˈsiːnəri/ — «сі-», а не «сце-».

items.pattern: dominate the landscape / the skyline / the view
items.meaning: be the biggest, most noticeable thing in a place, seen from far away
items.uk: панувати над місцевістю, височіти над усім довкола
items.example: A lonely volcano **dominates the landscape** of the island.
more: The cathedral still **dominates the skyline** of the town.
Two tall chimneys from the old factory **dominate the view** from our window.
items.watchOut: Dominate тут без прийменника: dominates the landscape, а не dominates over the landscape.

items.pattern: a beach / the coast / a forest stretches (for miles / along sth / as far as …)
items.meaning: a beach is very long and continues over a big distance
items.example: In front of the campsite, a wide **beach stretches** as far as you can see.
more: The forest **stretches** all the way to the border.
From the cliff top we could see the **beach stretching** for miles in both directions.
items.watchOut: Тягнеться на кілометри — stretches for miles, а не reaches for miles і не pulls (pull — тягнути щось руками). Reach — дістатися певного місця: the path reaches the village.

items.pattern: a sandy beach / bay / path · sandy soil
items.meaning: a beach covered with sand, not stones
items.example: The kids want a **sandy beach** so they can build sandcastles all day.
more: There's a small **sandy bay** just ten minutes' walk from the village.
This beach is all pebbles, but there's a **sandy** one on the other side of the harbour.
items.watchOut: Піщаний — sandy, а не sanded: sanded — відшліфований наждачкою. Пляж із галькою — a pebble beach (або a shingle beach).

items.pattern: a secluded beach / bay / spot / garden
items.meaning: a quiet, hidden beach that few people know about or visit
items.example: A local fisherman told us about a **secluded beach** that you can only reach by boat.
more: We found a **secluded spot** by the river for our picnic.
The holiday cottage has a **secluded garden** where nobody can see you.
items.watchOut: «Затишний пляж» у значенні «тихий, де мало людей» — a secluded beach. Cosy зазвичай кажуть про кімнату, кафе чи светр.

items.pattern: golden sands · miles of golden sand
items.meaning: beautiful yellow sand on a beach; a typical phrase in holiday adverts
items.uk: золотий пісок, пляжі із золотим піском
items.example: The brochure promised **golden sands** and blue sea, and for once it was true.
more: We spent the whole week lying on the **golden sands** with a good book.
The bay has two kilometres of **golden sand** and hardly any tourists.
items.watchOut: Про пісок кажуть golden sands; gold частіше означає «із золота» (a gold ring). Golden sands у множині — пляжі із золотим піском.

items.pattern: peaceful / tranquil countryside · a tranquil village / lake · tranquil is formal
items.meaning: quiet and calm countryside where nothing disturbs you
items.example: After a week in the noisy city, we spent two days in **tranquil countryside** and slept like babies.
more: The hotel is in **peaceful countryside**, twenty minutes from the nearest town.
We stayed by a **tranquil lake** where the only sound was the birds.
items.watchOut: Тиха, спокійна місцевість — peaceful (або формальніше tranquil) countryside. Silent означає «зовсім беззвучний», тож про спокійну місцевість частіше кажуть peaceful або quiet.

warmup.uk: Я зробив сотню фото на весіллі сестри.
warmup.q: I ___ a hundred photos at my sister's wedding.
warmup.explain: Фотографувати — take photos / take a picture. Make a photo — калька.

warmup.uk: Стежка до водоспаду йде крутим схилом.
warmup.q: The path to the waterfall goes up a ___ slope.
warmup.explain: Крутий схил — a steep slope. Cool — прохолодний або класний.

warmup.q: We all need to ___ the environment.
warmup.explain: Охороняти довкілля — protect the environment. Guard — стерегти, як охоронець.

warmup.uk: За нашим готелем на кілометри тягнеться пляж.
warmup.q: Behind our hotel, the beach ___ for miles.
warmup.explain: Пляж тягнеться — stretches. Pull — тягнути руками, reach — дістатися якогось місця.

warmup.uk: Цей старий міст справді варто побачити.
warmup.q: This old bridge is ___ worth seeing.
warmup.explain: Справді варто — well worth: well worth seeing, well worth a visit.

warmup.uk: На вихідних ми їздили за місто, на природу.
warmup.q: At the weekend we went to the ___.
warmup.explain: «Поїхати на природу» — go to the countryside, а не go to the nature.

warmup.q: We got lost in a ___ forest.
warmup.explain: Густий ліс — a dense (або thick) forest.

warmup.uk: З порома я на мить побачив дельфіна.
warmup.q: From the ferry I ___ a glimpse of a dolphin.
warmup.explain: Мигцем побачити — catch a glimpse of sth.

A.q: The castle was empty for two hundred years and slowly ___ into ruin.
A.explain: Занепасти — fall into ruin (минулий час — fell into ruin).

A.q: Tall hedges along the road ___ the view of the fields.
A.explain: Закривати вид — block the view. Close і stop тут — кальки.

A.q: Our friends got married in a beautiful ___ by a lake.
A.explain: Місце з усім, що довкола, — a setting. Set — знімальний майданчик або набір; scenery — незлічуване, з a не вживається.

B.q: From the plane window we had a ___ view of the Alps.
B.explain: Прикметник — spectacular. Spectacle — видовище, spectator — глядач.

B.q: Few tourists know about this ___ little beach, hidden between two cliffs.
B.explain: Secluded — тихий, схований від людей. Excluded — виключений, concluded — завершений.

B.q: If you hire a car, you'll find some breathtaking ___ in the north of the island.
B.explain: Scenery — незлічуване: some scenery, без -s і без a.

example.title: A walk to the castle
example.uk:
Минулої весни ми винайняли будиночок серед незайманої природи біля моря. Першого ж ранку ми пішли стежкою вздовж бурхливої річки до старого замку.

Коли ми вийшли з-за повороту, то мигцем побачили оленя, але він утік у густий ліс, перш ніж я встиг його сфотографувати. Через годину на вершині крутого схилу показався замок. Він перетворився на руїну ще кілька століть тому, але його справді варто побачити.

Ми вмостилися на старих мурах, щоб помилуватися краєвидом: удалині засніжені гори, а внизу піщаний пляж. Це був найкращий день відпустки.
example.en:
Last spring we rented a cottage in some [[unspoilt countryside|a21]] near the coast. On our first morning we [[followed a path|a7]] along a [[fast-flowing river|a19]] towards an old castle.

As we [[rounded a bend|a12]], we [[caught a glimpse of|a9]] a deer, but it ran into the [[dense forest|a22]] before I could [[take a picture|a10]]. An hour later the castle [[came into view|a13]] at the top of a [[steep slope|a18]]. It [[fell into ruin|a14]] centuries ago, but it's [[well worth seeing|a16]].

We sat on the old walls to [[admire the view|b4]]: [[snow-covered mountains|a24]] in the distance and a [[sandy beach|b8]] below. It was the best day of the holiday.
